content:
The test image shows split soybean stems with:
- **Bleached white, dead stem tissue**
- **Large, prominent black masses** embedded inside and on the stems — classic sclerotia
- No leaf symptoms visible; this is a stem cross-section

These black, irregularly-shaped hard bodies (sclerotia) inside bleached white dead stems are the hallmark diagnostic feature of **White Mold** (*Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*). The symptom description confirms: "Dry dead stems develop a bleached white appearance" and "characteristic black sclerotia are visible embedded within white mold on stem lesions... inside stems as the plant approaches death."

The Septoria reference image shows a very different presentation (leaf yellowing/defoliation), confirming this is not Septoria.
